title: Machine learning predicts plastic bronchitis in children with Mycoplasma pneumonia
summary: In 702 hospitalized children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (225 with plastic bronchitis), eight models using nine Lasso-Boruta-selected predictors reached test ROC-AUC 0.854 to 0.881 (random forest 0.881). Temporal validation and bootstrap optimism correction were also performed. The study is single-center and retrospective.
ai_technology: Lasso-Boruta feature selection with CatBoost, XGBoost, random forest and other classifiers, interpreted with SHAP

evidence.tested: Held-out test set, temporal validation and bootstrap optimism correction at one center.
evidence.unknown: Performance in other centers and effect on care are not reported; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selected predictors and trained models to predict plastic bronchitis risk.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
